title: Sale of a Leased Home: Transfer and Buyout Terms for the SunPath Solar Lease
content:
## Terms of the SunPath Solar Lease on a sale of the home

**(a) Two ways out on a sale.** When the home is sold, the lessee either transfers the lease to the home buyer or buys the system.

**(b) Transfer.** A home buyer assuming the lease must have a credit score of at least the system size's minimum for an assuming buyer. A transfer is processed within the system size's transfer processing time in calendar days. On the transfer the seller's lease becomes transferred.

**(c) Buyout window.** A buyout is allowed only after the system size's buyout waiting period in months has run from the permission-to-operate date.

**(d) Buyout price.** The buyout price is the system size's buyout price at the start of lease year six, declining by the system size's yearly decline percent each later lease year, rounded half up to the cent. The buyout price is billed as a buyout price line on the buyout date, and it adds to the lease balance. On a buyout the lease becomes bought out.

**(e) No other early exit.** Early termination without a transfer or a buyout is not offered where the system size does not allow early termination.

**(f) No relocation.** The system is never moved to another home.

## The terms at a glance

| Matter | Rule |
|---|---|
| Who may assume the lease on a sale | The home buyer, with a credit score at least the assuming buyer's minimum |
| Transfer processing | Within the transfer processing time, in calendar days |
| Earliest buyout | Only after the buyout waiting period, in months from the permission-to-operate date |
| Buyout price in lease year six | The buyout price at the start of lease year six |
| Buyout price in later lease years | Declines by the yearly decline percent each later lease year, rounded half up to the cent |
| How the buyout price is billed | As a buyout price line |
| Ending the lease early without a transfer or buyout | Not offered where early termination is not allowed for the size |
| Moving the system to another home | Never |

## Cases

- **Buyer's credit score.** The assuming buyer's minimum is 650 for every SunPath size. A hypothetical buyer scoring 650 meets the requirement and a buyer scoring 649 does not.
- **Buyout timing.** The buyout waiting period is 60 months for every SunPath size. On a hypothetical lease whose permission-to-operate date was 40 months ago, a buyout is not yet allowed; on a lease whose permission-to-operate date was 70 months ago it is.
- **Buyout price one year on.** With a hypothetical buyout price of $10000.00 at the start of lease year six and a decline of 6 percent, the buyout price in lease year seven is $10000.00 less 6 percent of it, which is $9400.00.
- **Relocation.** A hypothetical lessee moving to another Calloway home cannot take the leased system with them; the system is never moved to another home.
